title: The workday desk
description: The design direction: a useful daily place with a recognizable Sidefolk identity.

title: Today · connected
description: A time-led agenda. One distinct decision surface. Real recent writing, rather than notebook containers.

title: Today · everyday
description: The same useful product with no AI tools connected. No technical vocabulary or connection promotions.

title: Reminders
description: List first. Due times and repeats remain visible. Completion and More are the two row actions.

title: Reminder · editor
description: Explicit schedule, occurrence scope and timezone. Snooze moves one occurrence; the series anchor stays put.

title: Work log
description: Notebook navigation, readable dated entries, inline capture and a visible destination.

title: Your week
description: A factual weekly record of notes and completed reminders. Copy as Markdown; no invented productivity score.

title: Sessions
description: Project, first prompt line and host identify each session. Completed work can be logged deliberately.

title: Request · complete operation
description: The exact operation is prominent. No default approval. Handoff and expiry remain visible.

title: Request · edit diff
description: The actual before/after change stays readable, with the file path and session identity beside it.

title: Setup · first reminder
description: Value before configuration. Pip helps create one real reminder, with its resolved time shown.

title: Setup · permissions
description: Permission results are explicit. Denied notifications have a useful, honest consequence and recovery.

title: Setup · optional tools
description: One optional connection step. Waiting for the first live event is separate from an installation result.

title: Settings · General
description: A separate macOS-style settings window with four panes, outside the daily task navigation.

title: Settings · Companion
description: Pip and Spark keep their shipped identities. Character choice changes appearance, never capabilities.

title: Settings · Agents
description: One connection flow, honest health, and the host capability matrix. Codex is clearly beta.

title: Settings · Privacy & data
description: Local data, retention and export are understandable. Destructive actions are separated from daily work.

title: Desktop · companion moments
description: Tail-linked cards, the shipped character, one short sentence, and generous 44px controls.

title: Design system
description: An implementation palette, native type hierarchy, shared components and state vocabulary.

title: Recovery & edge states
description: Loading, empty, error, stale, unavailable and released states each explain the next useful action.

title: Quick add
description: One shared input, an explicit interpretation and a visible destination. Capture finishes where it starts.

title: Today · dark
description: The same hierarchy in the existing warm dark palette. No information depends on color alone.

title: Settings · dark
description: Native controls and readable layers follow the selected appearance.

title: Today · compact
description: At 720px, full navigation labels remain visible and the content follows its priority order.

title: Reminder · repeating series
description: Choose the occurrence or all future reminders, with a visible weekly anchor and unchanged future dates after snooze.

title: Quick add · reminder preview
description: A resolved date, time, zone and destination appear before saving.

title: Quick add · ambiguous time
description: An ambiguous hour becomes a choice. It is never silently guessed.

title: Quick add · notebook choice
description: Several near matches become an explicit destination choice. The note draft remains intact.

title: Request · released
description: Expired or handed-off requests lose their answer controls and show where to continue.

title: Request · long operation
description: Unread content has a clear boundary. Allow is absent until the complete operation has been shown.

title: Desktop · Spark
description: The alternative companion uses the same card language and 44px controls; the logo stays unchanged.

title: Design system · interaction states
description: Hover, focus, disabled, pending, validation and persistent Undo are designed alongside the default controls.

title: Reminder · create
description: A fresh reminder starts with a blank title and real date/time values, then shows the resolved schedule.

title: Setup · connection choice
description: The disconnected state offers Connect; the installed state separately waits for a real first event.
